lines.zh: 我走三步，鼻子就哼一声。
lines.en: Every three steps, my nose lets out a snort.

lines.zh: 一群五只，我们在沙上排成歪队。
lines.en: Five of us make a crooked line across the sand.

lines.zh: 我的名字念出来像打喷嚏。
lines.en: My name sounds like a sneeze when spoken.

lines.zh: 我扭着身子走，鳍拍着水。
lines.en: I waddle along, fins slapping the water.

lines.zh: 我打个喷嚏，整群就跟着散开。
lines.en: I sneeze and the whole group scatters.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我们，我们顺着走。
lines.en: The warm current pushes and we go with it.

lines.zh: 我走在队伍最后，边走边打鼾。
lines.en: Last in line, I snore as I walk.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的鳍，我扯了两下。
lines.en: Weeds snag my fin and I tug twice.

lines.zh: 我们走得慢，但从不走散。
lines.en: We walk slowly but never lose each other.

lines.zh: 我一边游一边抽鼻子，很难听。
lines.en: Swimming, I keep sniffing, and it sounds awful.

lines.zh: 前面那只停了，我撞了上去。
lines.en: The one ahead stops and I bump into it.

lines.zh: 沙被我们一群搅得像起了雾。
lines.en: Our group stirs the sand into a fog.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，肚子会咕咕响。
lines.en: As I walk, my belly gurgles loudly.

lines.zh: 这条海沟我们每天都走一遍。
lines.en: We walk this trench once every day.

lines.zh: 我一吸气，腮边就鼓成两个泡。
lines.en: One breath in, and two bulbs swell at my cheeks.

lines.zh: 浪把我们推成一排，谁也不肯让。
lines.en: The swell lines us up, and nobody yields.

lines.zh: 我浮在暖水里，鼻子还在抽。
lines.en: Floating in warm water, my nose still twitches.

lines.zh: 睡觉时我打鼾，整片礁都听得见。
lines.en: My snoring carries across the whole reef.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，其实已经睡着了。
lines.en: My eyes are half open, but I am asleep.

lines.zh: 一群挤在一起，谁都不想先醒。
lines.en: Packed together, none of us wants to wake first.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，把自己吓了一跳。
lines.en: I sneeze and startle myself.

lines.zh: 水面的光晃过来，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Light ripples down from the surface and I squint.

lines.zh: 我在慢慢嚼昨天剩下的东西。
lines.en: I am slowly chewing what was left from yesterday.

lines.zh: 我靠着珊瑚，鼻子泡在水里。
lines.en: Leaning on coral, I keep my nose in the water.

lines.zh: 有只小虾爬过我，我没醒。
lines.en: A little shrimp crawls over me and I sleep on.

lines.zh: 我鼻子痒，忍了很久才打出来。
lines.en: My nose tickles and I hold it in a long while.

lines.zh: 我们几个轮着打鼾，像有节奏。
lines.en: We take turns snoring, almost in rhythm.

lines.zh: 醒着也没事做，我就发呆。
lines.en: Awake with nothing to do, I stare at nothing.

lines.zh: 我在等水流把吃的带过来。
lines.en: I wait for the current to bring food along.

lines.zh: 安静的日子里，我的鼾声最响。
lines.en: On quiet days my snoring is the loudest thing.

lines.zh: 你站着的样子，比我高太多。
lines.en: Standing there, you are far taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻子先抽了一下。
lines.en: I look up at you and my nose twitches first.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: You smell of iron and I sneeze.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你手里有没有吃的。
lines.en: Head tilted, I check your hands for food.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的名字确实好笑。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? My name is funny.

lines.zh: 我躲到同类后面，只露出鼻子。
lines.en: I hide behind kin with only my nose out.

lines.zh: 你靠近的时候，我们一群都停了。
lines.en: When you come near, our whole group freezes.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小小的，水里的动静躲不过。
lines.en: My tiny eyes miss nothing that moves in the water.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才敢呼吸。
lines.en: You step back and only then do I breathe.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，直到你眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at you until you blink.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我发出一声长哼。
lines.en: You hit me and I let out a long snort.

lines.zh: 我鼻子流血，闻不到东西了。
lines.en: My nose bleeds and I can smell nothing.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，别踩。
lines.en: I'm coming out of the sand. Don't step.

lines.zh: 我发出声音，同伴都看过来。
lines.en: I cry out and every companion turns to look.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还是护着身后的几只。
lines.en: It hurts, yet I still shield the ones behind me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了一道，游得慢了。
lines.en: A tear in my fin slows my swimming.

lines.zh: 别打第二下，我快憋不住气。
lines.en: Not a second blow; I can barely hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，鼾声变成了喘。
lines.en: I curl up and my snoring turns to panting.

lines.zh: 伤口在暖水里散开，像一团雾。
lines.en: The wound spreads through warm water like mist.

lines.zh: 我们受伤的时候，会靠得更紧。
lines.en: When hurt, we press closer together.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔下来，我们全冲上去。
lines.en: You drop a fish and we all rush it.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道就打喷嚏，忍不住。
lines.en: The smell makes me sneeze; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 食物一落水，我们五只一起挤。
lines.en: Food hits the water and all five of us crowd in.

lines.zh: 我推别人，抢最靠前那一口。
lines.en: I shove the others to get the first bite.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold your hand steady; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我不挑，只要还带水的都要。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything still wet will do.

lines.zh: 吃太急，我把海水也吞了。
lines.en: Eating too fast, I swallow seawater too.

lines.zh: 我给同类留一点，因为都熟。
lines.en: I leave a little for the others; we are close.

lines.zh: 你拍两下水面，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: Two slaps on the water and I know food is here.

lines.zh: 吃完我会对你哼一声，算谢了。
lines.en: After eating I snort at you, which is thanks.

lines.zh: 撞到我，我会像球一样滚开。
lines.en: Bump me and I roll away like a ball.

lines.zh: 我鼻子软，顶到你会有点湿。
lines.en: My nose is soft; touching you leaves it damp.

lines.zh: 你踩我尾巴，我哼了一声就走。
lines.en: You step on my tail; I snort and move off.

lines.zh: 一群挤过来，把你也围住了。
lines.en: The group crowds in and surrounds you as well.

lines.zh: 我们互相撞着走，从来不理。
lines.en: We bump each other constantly and never care.

lines.zh: 你踢我，我打着喷嚏跑两步。
lines.en: You kick me and I run two steps, sneezing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿蹭过去，湿了一片。
lines.en: I brush past your leg and leave it wet.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我鼻子更痒了。
lines.en: That collision made my nose itch worse.

lines.zh: 我撞到珊瑚，反过来怪它。
lines.en: I bump the coral and blame the coral.

lines.zh: 别推我，我身后还有四只。
lines.en: Do not shove me; four more stand behind me.

lines.zh: 我哼一段调子，看谁愿意应。
lines.en: I hum a little tune and see who answers.

lines.zh: 她跟着我走了一整片暖水。
lines.en: She followed me across a whole stretch of warm water.

lines.zh: 我们用鼻子互相顶一下，就算成。
lines.en: We tap noses once and consider it settled.

lines.zh: 一窝小的出生时都在打喷嚏。
lines.en: The whole litter sneezes the moment they are born.

lines.zh: 我们一共五只，睡成一堆。
lines.en: Five of us sleep in one heap.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最大的那一口。
lines.en: I saved the biggest mouthful for her.

lines.zh: 她走开一会儿，我就到处找。
lines.en: She steps away briefly and I search everywhere.

lines.zh: 繁殖季水暖，我们叫得最响。
lines.en: In the warm breeding season, we are loudest.

lines.zh: 小的长得很快，鼾声也学得快。
lines.en: The young grow fast and learn to snore fast.

lines.zh: 我们在一起，就没人敢靠近。
lines.en: Together, we keep everyone at a distance.

lines.zh: 我用嘴捡起一块骨头渣。
lines.en: I pick up a bone chip with my mouth.

lines.zh: 东西沉，我含着一半又掉了。
lines.en: The thing is heavy; I hold half and drop it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西的时候鼻子会贴地。
lines.en: When I pick things up, my nose touches the ground.

lines.zh: 骨粉沾了我一身，白得像落霜。
lines.en: Bone meal coats me white as frost.

lines.zh: 我抱着鱼，其他几只来抢。
lines.en: I hug the fish and the others come to steal it.

lines.zh: 那些小东西我都不放过。
lines.en: I never leave small things where they lie.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满，就叫不出来。
lines.en: With my mouth full, I cannot make a sound.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，我们分着搬。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, we carry off in shares.

lines.zh: 我拖着一大块，走得一歪一歪。
lines.en: Dragging something big, I lurch from side to side.

lines.zh: 捡到亮的东西，我藏进沙里。
lines.en: Anything bright I find, I hide in the sand.

lines.zh: 水里一有动静，我鼻子先停。
lines.en: At the first stir in the water, my nose stops.

lines.zh: 我盯上那只落单的小鱼。
lines.en: I fix on the little fish that fell behind.

lines.zh: 五只一起转头，声音很齐。
lines.en: Five heads turn together, almost in unison.

lines.zh: 有血腥味，我就慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: There is blood in the water; I drift toward it.

lines.zh: 你手上的腥味，比你的脚步更近。
lines.en: The fish smell on you is nearer than your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我一旦记住谁，就跟着不放。
lines.en: Once I remember someone, I keep following.

lines.zh: 这个目标有点大，我在犹豫。
lines.en: This target is rather large, and I hesitate.

lines.zh: 同伴一动，我也跟着动。
lines.en: When my companions move, I move with them.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，不管它在多深的水里。
lines.en: I smell it, however deep the water.

lines.zh: 谁撞了我，我就记谁。
lines.en: Whoever bumps me, I remember.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进沙里，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I bury my nose in sand and creep closer.

lines.zh: 我们几个散开，把它围住。
lines.en: We spread out and close around it.

lines.zh: 我在等它游出珊瑚的阴影。
lines.en: I wait until it swims out of the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我们就往前挤一步。
lines.en: Each time it turns, we press one step closer.

lines.zh: 我不叫，鼾声也停了。
lines.en: I make no sound; even my snoring stops.

lines.zh: 我在算它离水草多远。
lines.en: I am measuring its distance from the weeds.

lines.zh: 它慌了，我的鼻子就开始抽。
lines.en: It panics, and my nose begins to twitch.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the sand and make as little noise as I can.

lines.zh: 再往前一格，它就躲不掉了。
lines.en: One more block and it has nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 同伴看着我，等我先动。
lines.en: My companions watch me, waiting for me to move.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，还打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: I bite down and sneeze at the same time.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞，撞得自己都晕。
lines.en: I ram with my body and daze myself too.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但五只一起上。
lines.en: This blow is light, but five of us strike.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，像叼着一块布。
lines.en: I clamp on as if holding a piece of cloth.

lines.zh: 我的牙钝，只能磨出红印。
lines.en: My teeth are blunt and only leave red marks.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你扯得站不稳。
lines.en: I shake my head and pull you off balance.

lines.zh: 别笑，被围住的时候很麻烦。
lines.en: Do not laugh; being surrounded is troublesome.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，让同伴补上。
lines.en: I hit, retreat, and let a companion take over.

lines.zh: 这一口带着海水的腥味。
lines.en: This bite comes with the taste of salt water.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，又扑了上去。
lines.en: I snort once and lunge again.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我们一次来三到五只。
lines.en: In warm oceans we arrive three to five at a time.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，先打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: I climb out of the sand and sneeze first.

lines.zh: 没有蛋，我们只是某天出现在这里。
lines.en: No egg: one day we simply appear here.

lines.zh: 第一口气吸进的是暖水和沙。
lines.en: My first breath was warm water and sand.

lines.zh: 我们一出生就挤成一团。
lines.en: The moment we are born we crowd into a heap.

lines.zh: 这片礁石认得我们的鼾声。
lines.en: This reef knows our snoring.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，同类已经在旁边走。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, kin were already walking beside me.

lines.zh: 我们从来不知道父母是谁。
lines.en: We never learn who our parents were.

lines.zh: 水暖的那几天，我们来得最多。
lines.en: On the warm days we come in the greatest numbers.

lines.zh: 落地时我鼻子就痒，一直没好。
lines.en: My nose itched from the moment I landed.

lines.zh: 水面上起火，我的皮被烫得发紧。
lines.en: Fire on the water makes my skin tighten and burn.

lines.zh: 被抛上岸，我拍在沙上喘不过气。
lines.en: Thrown ashore, I slap the sand and cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鼻子吸不进东西。
lines.en: Out of water, my nose draws in nothing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我们一群全掀翻了。
lines.en: The explosion flips our whole group over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，我哼了一声才倒下。
lines.en: An arrow passes through me; I snort, then fall.

lines.zh: 药水的味道钻进鼻子，我连打喷嚏。
lines.en: Potion fumes fill my nose and I sneeze and sneeze.

lines.zh: 饿极了，我连沙都嚼。
lines.en: Starving, I even chew the sand.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我浑身一抖就僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I jerk, then stiffen.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉了我，连哼都没哼完。
lines.en: The void swallows me before my snort finishes.
